description: Forced six-step at duty 0.126, chosen so the current vector matches the FOC legs at about 0.53 A. Angle is forced, so this isolates the commutation scheme from the angle source.
notes: Matched-current leg of the three-scheme sweep on the small bench motor (flux 0.937 mWb, 7 pole pairs).

Ripple UNDER-RESOLVED at 2.8 samples per ripple period — the figure is a lower bound. Both schemes are sampled identically at this speed, so the ratio between them remains valid even though the absolute values do not.
title: Six-step (trapezoidal), 898 rad/s el
